paragraphs: ADS Environmental Services provides flow, level and rainfall monitoring for wastewater, storm and surface water systems. The buyers are municipal owners who need to know what is happening in their collection systems when it rains. The problems addressed include sanitary sewer overflows, sewer cleaning, combined sewer overflows and inflow and infiltration.

Monitors in the sewer feed software for visualizing, analyzing and managing the network. An agency can buy the equipment and run the program with its own staff. At the other end of the range, the company handles everything from placing the equipment to sending the alerts. A newer offering applies machine learning to spot developing blockages early enough to act on them.

Peter Petroff established the company in 1975 after a NASA career as a lunar guidance system engineer. A network of more than 400 monitors in Sydney, Australia in 1990 is described as a milestone in the company history. Product quality management certifications have been held since 1994, including an ISO 9001:2015 certificate issued by CSA Group. Offices sit across North America and Australia, with the corporate office in Huntsville, Alabama, and open roles are posted within IDEX Corporation.
